verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Omnara is free to self-host under Apache 2.0, with organization/project role assignment. Nothing documents an enterprise license tier, SSO integration, or commercial support offering. RBAC is an adjacent access-control feature and does not count as SSO or an enterprise licensing deal.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can license an enterprise deployment with SSO and commercial support for organization-wide rollout
